thread:
sophie: Heads up — deploybot flagged our EU canary for release 2026.03.21 as failing SBOM provenance check (missing cosign signature) and an ambiguous license for libfoo. We're in the 10:00-12:00 change window. Can security/legal advise fast? @chris @legal-erin :eyes:

deploybot: [SCAN] 3821123456 | artifact: quay.io/redwood/inference:2026.03.21-eu-canary
SBOM: https://artifacts/reports/3821123456-sbom.json
Findings:
- provenance: missing cosign attestation header (Build-Signature) — policy: PROVENANCE_REQUIRED
- license: libfoo 1.2.3 -> ambiguous (dual-license detection) — policy: LICENSE_NOISE
- vuln: CVE-2025-1234 (low) — introduced via optional dep

chris: @sophie can you paste image digest and the SBOM snippet for libfoo? need to triage if it's an actual license change or false positive.

sophie: image sha256:abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890
SBOM excerpt: ```{"packages":[{"name":"libfoo","version":"1.2.3","licenses":["MIT","SEE-LICENSE"]}]}```
link to artifacts: https://artifacts/internal/sha256/abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890

security-bot: policy-check FAILED: provenance_required. Escalation level: 2. Suggest manual approval or artifact pin.

legal-erin: quick read — 'SEE-LICENSE' often means license file in repo, need evidence. If it's MIT-compatible we can approve. Can security confirm the file contents? If not, propose timeboxed exception for EU canary only (2 hours) with audit log and staged rollback.

tim: engineering suggestion — we can pin libfoo to 1.2.2 which has explicit MIT. That requires a rebuild and quick smoke. Alternative: allow canary at 5% for 30m with monitoring and auto rollback on errors.

sophie: rebuilding will take ~30-45m and would push past change window. prefer staged 5% canary now if legal+security ok. Monitoring: prometheus alerts on 5xx and latency; auto rollback if error rate >0.5% over 5m.

chris: ok from security if:
- canary limited to EU region 5%
- auto-rollback configured as stated
- audit note created in release ticket
I will +1 in channel once Security Bot policy-exception is recorded.

legal-erin: +1 for timeboxed exception. Please add the SBOM artifact link to the ticket and tag me. I'll write a brief approval note.

deploybot: Scheduled rollout: region=eu, percent=5, start=3821123520, auto_rollback_on=error_rate>0.5%:5m

sophie: thanks all — I'm going to proceed with the 5% canary and link the approval in the release notes. ping me if anything unexpected :thumbsup:

chris: adding final note: please confirm when the cosign attestation is attached post-rollout so we can close the exception.

sophie: noted — will follow up with attestation or pin plan.
